description: This file contains NEON-optimized implementations of image processing functions, including computation of mean, standard deviation, and cross-correlation on floating-point data, specifically tailored for ARM NEON architecture. It also includes headers and utility functions related to object tracking within the TensorFlow Android project.

methods.name: float GetSum(const float32x4_t & values)

methods.description: Calculates the mean of a float array using NEON instructions, with sanity check comparison against CPU implementation.

methods.name: float ComputeStdDevNeon(const float * const values,const int num_vals,const float mean)
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of a float array using NEON instructions, with sanity check comparison.

methods.name: float ComputeCrossCorrelationNeon(const float * const values1,const float * const values2,const int num_vals)
methods.description: Calculates the cross-correlation between two float arrays using NEON instructions, with sanity check comparison.
